content.short: Stablecoin acceptance and same-day USD wires for exporters.
content.description: Shield is a crypto neobank built for global exporters and trade businesses that struggle with slow, jammed international wires. It lets companies accept and send compliant stablecoin payments to suppliers and buyers anywhere in the world, so funds that leave as USDT over networks like Ethereum and Tron arrive as US dollars the same day, every time. Alongside stablecoin acceptance, Shield offers same-day USD wire settlement, compliance, and treasury tooling designed for the realities of cross-border trade. Backed by investors including a16z crypto and Giant Ventures, Shield targets manufacturers, exporters, and trade intermediaries who need fast, predictable settlement across corridors that traditional correspondent banking handles slowly and expensively, turning stablecoins into reliable rails for global commerce.
